SystemSettingsView.title: System settings
SystemSettingsView.subtitle: Configuration file of this installation (settings.ini)
SystemSettingsView.notice: Changes take effect with the next request. A backup copy is created before saving; comments in the file are lost. Under Docker the container recreates the file on every start.
SystemSettingsView.notWritable: The file is not writable for the web server. Changes cannot be saved here.
SystemSettingsView.extraHint: The form does not know these entries. They are kept when saving.
SystemSettingsView.warnDatabase: The new database access is tried before saving. Reload PHP-FPM afterwards, because existing connections keep the old access.
SystemSettingsView.warnCookie: A new cookie name logs out all users.
SystemSettingsView.warnDemo: In demo mode the demo database is reset regularly. Never enable it on an installation with real data.
SystemSettingsView.savedReload: Saved. Please reload PHP-FPM so that the new database access applies.
SystemSettingsView.invalidChars: No line breaks, quotation marks or backslashes

database.auth_db: Auth database with users, rights and clients
database.auth_pass: Password of the database user, stored obfuscated

session.cookie_same_site: SameSite rule of the session cookie

logging.api_log_file: File for the log of API calls
logging.max_log_size: Size in bytes after which the log file is renamed

system.templates_dir: Print and shop templates, relative paths start at backend/
system.shop_sites_dir: Limit for the directories of the shop websites
system.shop_publish_command_path: Program that builds the shop website, fallback for the shop setting

demo.enabled: Demo mode, data is reset regularly

company.admin_users: Logins with system administration, separated by commas

errors.DB_CONNECTION_FAILED: No connection with the new database access. Nothing saved.
errors.WOULD_LOCK_OUT: You would remove your own system administration. Nothing saved.
errors.NO_PERMISSION: Only system administrators may change the system settings.
